{{Quote|I'm Fixer Twelve. Used to be a field operative, but these days I keep this place running.|Fixer Twelve|<ref name="Get to" />}}
'''Fixer Twelve''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. An [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of [[Operations Division]], he was originally a field operative until his [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] received severe damage when a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] stabbed him with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He then became a Fixer assigned to the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]].<ref name="Get to" />

After the dissolution of Imperial Intelligence, he was later present aboard the ''[[Tenebrous (starship)|Tenebrous]]'' when [[Cipher Nine]] was brought aboard from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to meet with the [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Minister of Intelligence]] and overhauled [[Cipher Nine's X-70B Phantom-class prototype]] in order for it to be undetected on its approach to the [[Star Chamber (space station)|Star Chamber]].<ref name="Star Chamber">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Star Chamber|Corellia}}</ref>
